name: Rogers Corporation
description: Rogers Corp designs develop and manufactures engineered materials and components for sale to original equipment manufacturers and component suppliers. The firm operates in three business segments: Advanced Electronics Solutions, which manufactures circuit materials for applications in communications infrastructure, automotive, and consumer electronics markets; elastomeric material solutions, which provide cushioning, sealing, and impact protection in automotive, transportation, and construction applications; and Other, which consists of elastomer components for applications in the general industrial market, as well as elastomer floats for level sensing in fuel tanks, motors, and storage tanks applications in the general industrial and automotive markets.
